about_the_game:
Dive into a whole new kind of workbench repair work - fixing electronic toys! In this playful DLC, you’ll troubleshoot and repair quirky gadgets like a remote-controlled robot, levitating drone, and even a haunted EMF detector... yes, ghosts might be involved.

🤖Test your skills with interactive repairs, moving parts, and creative mechanics - all in immersive VR. Take control of toys like never before!

⚡Because even the smallest circuits can spark the biggest fun.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, PlayStationVR or Meta Quest headset
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 3060 6GB / AMD RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires Valve Index, PlayStationVR or Meta Quest headset

supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
